newsitem.title: ITALY: Revised data for Italy's public admin accounts.
newsitem.headline: Revised data for Italy's public admin accounts.

text.p: The following are the main points of revised data for Italy's public administration accounts over the past four years, which were released by the Treasury on Monday.

Note: The Treasury has previously given state sector deficit data, but because the European Union's Maastricht Treaty demands public administration figures, Italy has decided to switch the emphasis of its accounts onto this.

It said that the final state sector deficit figure for 1996 was 131.96 trillion lire against a previous estimate of 138 trillion. The final data came in lower than forecast because of a recent decision by the EU statistics office, Eurostat, to accept changes in state accouting methods.
